body:
## Exact #24 gap

Replace dimension-by-dimension examples with a theorem for **every integer physical dimension at least two** in the smooth precompact spacelike two-face core of `notes/general-contract.md` section 3, specialized to flat ambient metric and the stated ambient-interval containment. Use local face/joint atlases where required; no new global graph or combined-slope restriction. Explicitly state any geometric coverage not delivered rather than calling a graph subclass the general flat core.

## Actual inputs and nonduplication

Consume #132 / PR #140 (`notes/dimension-five-six-short.md` section 7), #78's actual long producers, #92's intrinsic geometry, #77's expectation normalization and the integrated 2D/3D/4D results. **The bounded C4 5D/6D written deterministic and expectation corollaries already exist in #132.** Do not refile their elementary addition as new mathematical progress. They are calibrations, not all-dimensional coverage; optional formal ports belong to the explicit #86 verification ledger until justified.

## Acceptance

- Derive actual dimension-indexed short and long phase densities, critical-order primitive/derivative bounds, fractional/log responses, endpoint contacts and summable remainder control from smooth geometry. Prove finite regularity needed at each dimension; do not claim the historical C3 class suffices.
- Derive ordinary sphere moments, signed kernel moments and physical normalization from the existing dimension-indexed kernel. Neither copying 4D coefficients nor assuming a universal positive Taylor inverse is permitted.
- Prove the complete independent joint target and deterministic limit with one common positive fixed cutoff, strict-short/equality-long allocation and all partners. Include odd/even regimes, 2D all-endpoint counting, disconnected regions, height critical points and nonzero source/Hessian controls.
- Transfer expectation separately using the actual law and discharged region/order/interval hypotheses. Preserve existing observables and prove compatibility rather than redefining them.
- Deliver a conventional quantified theorem with an exact dimension/geometry coverage map, or a complete-action obstruction and corrected statement. If only a restricted theorem is obtainable, retain and file the precise residual core blockers under #81; a list of successful dimensions does not complete this contract.

## Completion and integration discipline

This is a native #81 child on the main route to #24, not authorization to broaden the conjecture. Preserve #90's canonical action, independent geometric target, probability law and exact selected order. No desired jet, cancellation, expectation equality or limit may be an admissibility field. Retain both endpoint measures, every causal partner, all ordered cross-chart terms and the physical point term exactly once.

A failed estimate or isolated surviving sector is not a counterexample. A negative resolution requires an admissible fixed region and its **complete normalized action**, followed by the precise corrected statement and residual owners. A narrower result must leave the unsolved parent contract visibly open; feasibility or conditional inputs do not establish general coverage. If a genuine general theorem already covers a selected test geometry, discharge that test by verifying its hypotheses and instantiating the theorem instead of duplicating an example-specific proof.

Start from current `origin/issue-81-general-coverage`; use a separate task branch and target the PR there with `Refs`, not automatic closure language. Coordinate shared definitions before edits. Written proof, compiled proof, executable diagnostics and independent human review are separate. Written-first unless this issue explicitly requires a port. No unnecessary formal port: record any actual verification gap for #86. If Lean/checker/dependency/build inputs change, use the pinned-ancestor incremental workflow and one required full local integrated audit after final relevant changes; otherwise run relevant lightweight/Markdown checks. A prior audit does not certify a changed combined tree.

No noncompact tails, finite-regularity relaxation, degenerating-angle uniformity, shrinking cutoff, rates, sample-wise convergence, Conjecture 2 timelike extension, agent launch, merge, deployment or automatic #81/#24 closure.

Native prerequisites: #132, #77, #92, #90. Their accepted source outputs, not administrative closure alone, discharge these prerequisites.
title: Prove the all-dimensional smooth flat two-face critical-order producers and global limits
